title: Confuso - Weapon Stats & Location (Expedition 33)
description: Confuso in Clair Obscur: Expedition 33 - which character uses it, its element and scaling, and exactly where to get it.

sections.title: Overview
sections.content: Confuso is a light-element weapon used by Gustave / Verso. It scales with Agility (D), Luck (C).

sections.title: How to Get the Confuso
sections.content:
Location: Visages - Joy Vale.

Obtained from Visages - Joy Vale.

sections.title: Is the Confuso Worth Using?
sections.content: Scales off Agility (D), Luck (C). A dedicated light pick - it belongs in a build already committed to that element.
